title: perf(formula): the expression type checks build each typed check environment once per input, not once per call
body:
Fixes #34756

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：表达式类型检查（`firstTypeMismatch`、`firstDateTextVerdict`、`firstDateTextCall`）以前每调用一次就重建一个带类型的 CEL 环境（克隆注册表、重新注册整套标准库）。现在按输入（作用域、日期类型、字段类型）缓存复用，最多 512 个，按最近最少使用淘汰。
- 为什么改：发布任何一个元数据时，运行时校验会把整个应用的每条表达式都检查一遍。实测在 showcase 上发布一个对象，要建 903 个环境（只有 97 种不同输入），光这一项就占约 0.5 秒。dogfood 的字段重排用例因此在繁忙的合并队列分片上超过 5 秒时限，把无关 PR 踢出了队列。
- 风险与回滚：检查只做解析和类型检查，共用环境与新建环境给出相同结论，报告内容不变；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts`（缓存键与淘汰）、`packages/formula/src/cel-env-reuse.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/formula exec vitest run src/cel-env-reuse.test.ts`，预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The type checks behind the authoring rules built a new typed CEL environment on every call. Each build clones cel-js's registry and registers the whole stdlib again. The runtime authoring gate runs these checks over every expression in the stack each time a metadata item is published, so the cost grows with the size of the stack, not with the size of the item.

- `packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts`: the environments are kept per input (scope, date typing and field types), up to 512, least recently used first. The checks only parse and type-check against these environments, so a shared one gives the same verdicts as a fresh one.

## Tests

- `packages/formula/src/cel-env-reuse.test.ts` (an existing harness; a new `#34756` describe): repeated checks of one field map build no new environment; the field types are part of the key, so the same source keeps each map's own verdict; the scope and temporal typing are part of the key too. The 512-entry cap and its eviction order have no pin of their own: noted for the L1 review.

## Acceptance notes

- Opened by the seat on the maintainer's order (「#34638、#34756 由席位代开 PR」): the cloud dev session `session_012MmDsP9M4FjNJxrUMf7ESW` pushed this branch, and its own permission classifier refused its relay `pr_create`. This body is the seat's, written from the pushed commit and changeset.
- Root cause, as the dev measured it: no timer or polling wait. The two cases paid the publish path's per-expression environment rebuilds (about 0.5 s per publish on an idle machine; more under queue load). No per-case timeout was raised or added, per the card's fence.
- `packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts` is also edited by PR #34935 (#34662). The seat runs the overlap check before landing either.

## Verification

Measured by the dev on the showcase (from the changeset): one object publish built 903 environments for 97 distinct inputs; the publish request went from about 1.6–1.8 s to about 1.0–1.3 s on an idle machine. CI on this PR, and a dogfood run of `object-designer-field-reorder.dogfood.test.ts` under load, are the seat's to read before landing.
